address: Andijan (regional sales contact only; factory HQ in Chilanzar district, Tashkent)
materials_brands_mentioned: Orient Kerama / Orient Ceramic (own brand porcelain tile and ceramic tile, produced in Uzbekistan)
key_messages: Uzbekistan-manufactured porcelain tile and ceramic tile producer; dedicated Andijan regional contact line (distinct from its Namangan line, +998 91 349 77 27)
raw_notes: Included as a Showroom-adjacent lead despite unconfirmed local physical presence because it is the only porcelain/ceramic tile manufacturer found with an explicit, dedicated Andijan-region contact number - worth field-verifying whether it operates a local sales point or dealer in Andijan city itself.
